title: Appeal 15350: no-build easement in place of fire-rated wall and eave near a new lot line (ORSC R302.1)
jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record
code_edition: 2014 ORSC cited in the record (info sheet 'ORSC SECTION 302.1'); covenant also cites 2014 ORSC 302.1 and Table 301.1

facts.text: Appeal item requests a no-build easement as the alternative to the R302.1 requirement, to allow a lot confirmation while existing on-site structures are retained.
The covenant draft describes a 86-foot by 4-foot no-build easement widening to 5 feet over the western 19 feet, with a separate exhibit map.
The covenant states the alternate method addresses openings and an unprotected eave/exterior wall less than 3 feet from the property line under the 2014 ORSC Section 302.1 and Table 301.1.
Staff's pre-appeal life-safety review (April 19, 2017) states that eaves less than three feet from the lot line must be protected on the underside as required for one-hour fire-rated construction.
